sql: WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT 1917 UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y<2019), f AS (SELECT id_bioguide,min(term_start) first FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide HAVING min(term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'), snapshots AS (SELECT f.*,printf('%04d-12-31',y) dt FROM f JOIN years ON y>=cast(substr(first,1,4) as int)), active AS (SELECT s.*,cast(substr(dt,1,4) as int)-cast(substr(first,1,4) as int) calendar,cast((julianday(dt)-julianday(first))/365.25 as int) floor36525,cast(round((julianday(dt)-julianday(first))/365.25) as int) round36525,cast(round((julianday(dt)-julianday(first))/365) as int) round365 FROM snapshots s WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=s.id_bioguide AND dt BETWEEN term_start AND term_end)), modes AS (SELECT 'calendar' mode,calendar p,* FROM active UNION ALL SELECT 'floor36525',floor36525,* FROM active UNION ALL SELECT 'round36525',round36525,* FROM active UNION ALL SELECT 'round365',round365,* FROM active) SELECT mode,p,count(distinct id_bioguide) uncensored,count(distinct CASE WHEN dt<='1999-12-31' THEN id_bioguide END) censored FROM modes WHERE p BETWEEN 0 AND 20 GROUP BY mode,p ORDER BY mode,p
